messages:
Sam: quick post-launch micro-decision: three customer issues + one internal perf ask. need to agree bug vs enhancement and sprint placement. short replies pls.

Irene: paste IDs?

Sam: support dump:
```
RD-12001  embeddings drop for long docs (CustR)
RD-12009  streaming resume sends duplicate chunks (CustS)
RD-12015  console: prompt-template save sometimes fails on slow networks (multiple customers)
RD-12022  perf: reduce tokenizer overhead for short-requests (internal)
```

Devon: read: RD-12001 regression -> bug P0. RD-12009 intermittent but could be retry logic bug -> P1. RD-12015 UX bug but low code risk -> quick patch. RD-12022 is opt-in perf win, high ROI.

Maya: Ops note  RD-12009 traces show duplicate when proxy retries while upstream reconnects. simple mitigation: enforce idempotency-key in stream handshake. low-risk config change. full fix touches streaming pipeline.

Sam: proposal:
- Sprint 1 (this 10d cycle): RD-12001 hotfix (owner: Devon), RD-12009 mitigation as config flip (owner: Maya), fast UX patch RD-12015 if <1d.
- Sprint 2: RD-12022 tokenizer opt spike + perf bench (owner: DevInfra).

Devon: I can take RD-12001. estimate 2.5 dev-days + 1 qa day. acceptance: reproducer in harness, unit/regression test, 5% canary 24h, customer verification.

Maya: I'll roll out the idempotency-key flip to staging and list impacted customers. ops watchers please sign off.

QA-Bot: Ticket RD-12100 created by Sam: "post-launch split: RD-12001 hotfix + RD-12009 mitigation"

Irene: PM ask  can we send a one-line note to CustR and CustS after we confirm sprint placement? say: "we're shipping a hotfix this sprint / mitigation in staging today; will update on canary results."

Sam: yes I'll draft both notes once Devon confirms ETA.

Devon: will open branch + repro by EOD tomorrow.

Maya: will post staging logs and link SOP.

Irene: +1

Sam: vote check  react +1 if agreed with sprint split.

Devon: +1

Maya: +1

Irene: +1

Sam: thanks all  moving to weekly roadmap board.
